description: This file defines configuration settings and utility functions for managing stream settings in an auto-reply system, including default values, resolution functions, and visibility controls for session update tags.

methods.name: clampBoolean
methods.description: Utility to clamp a value to a boolean, with fallback.

methods.name: resolveAcpDeliveryMode
methods.description: Resolves the delivery mode string, defaulting if invalid.

methods.name: resolveAcpHiddenBoundarySeparator
methods.description: Resolves the boundary separator type, with fallback.

methods.name: resolveAcpStreamCoalesceIdleMs
methods.description: Resolves the coalesce idle milliseconds from config.

methods.name: resolveAcpStreamMaxChunkChars
methods.description: Resolves the maximum chunk characters from config.

methods.name: resolveAcpProjectionSettings
methods.description: Generates projection settings based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveAcpStreamingConfig
methods.description: Resolves streaming configuration, adjusting for live mode.

methods.name: isAcpTagVisible
methods.description: Determines if a specific session update tag is visible based on settings.
